title: Source census on SPLIT: release every surface hold every 1,500 ticks and record the tile in each wave's six-tuple and where it entered
fork: kills F2 (A weighted, B positional, C site tile plus block-biome tile)

predictions.expects: each wave's tile matches the half of the map edge it entered from
waves spread across the site's two tiles and their block-biome tile(s) without regard to the entry edge or quantity
tile shares follow the tiles' quantity shares

kill_criterion: at least twelve surface waves per replicate; a wave whose tile disagrees with its entry edge kills B
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save
count only waves first listed after the first release
